display.purpose: Hero headline only; middle line in translucent mist.

headline.purpose: Section headings with an optional mist continuation clause.

label.purpose: Field and spec keys, sentence case.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button fill: snow on the dark world.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f2f6f6; color: #0d1a1e; font: 500 1rem 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4) inset, 0 6px 20px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5); transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e9a23b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Well Field
components.description: Date field inside a glass panel; opens the calendar.
components.css: .ds-glass { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #142529; } .ds-field { display: grid; text-align: left; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(4,10,12,.42); color: #f2f6f6; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field:hover { background: rgba(4,10,12,.62); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(242,246,246,.12); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e9a23b; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-k { font-size: .78rem; color: #93b2b8; } .ds-v { font-size: .98rem; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(11,22,26,.8); } .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: none; color: rgba(242,246,246,.8); font: 400 .98rem 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s, color .25s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(242,246,246,.08); color: #fff; } .ds-tab.is-on { background: #f2f6f6; color: #0d1a1e; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e9a23b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,216,218,.14); background: none; color: #c9d8da; font: 400 .875rem 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #1d3338; color: #f2f6f6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e9a23b; outline-offset: 3px; }

keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed photography inside a rounded inset frame with a translucent rim.
Two-tone headings: statement in snow, continuation clause in mist at the same size.
Dark glass panels with darker inner "well" fields, never nested cards.
Solid white buttons with near-black text; no coloured buttons.
Amber appears on the mark, map pins, review stars and focus rings, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Lit Window Rule
rules.body: Amber is a light source, not a surface: marks, pins, stars, focus. Never a button fill, section ground, or heading colour.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: The page has exactly two grounds: Dusk Slate and Morning Fog. Photographs supply all other colour.

rules.name: The Second Clause Rule
rules.body: A heading may continue into a second sentence set in mist at the same size. That continuation replaces subtitles and eyebrows; there are no kickers above headings.

rules.name: The No Bold Rule
rules.body: Weights stop at 500. Emphasis is size or tone.

rules.name: The Rim Not Border Rule
rules.body: Photographic frames get an inset translucent rim, never an opaque border.
